name: Earth
overview: Scripture reveals that the earth was created by God at the beginning of all things, as affirmed in Genesis 1:1, and its structure was divinely ordered, with the firmament separating the waters above and below (Genesis 1:6-7). The earth's original perfection was marred by human sin, resulting in a curse upon the ground that brings forth thorns and thistles, signifying the consequences of disobedience (Genesis 3:17-18). Despite this, the earth remains under God's sovereign design and blessing, as illustrated by the enduring blessings extending to the everlasting hills (Genesis 49:26).
